# Lab 10.13: Configure Shared VPC

## What We Are Going to Do
Make one project the Shared VPC host, attach a service project, and let a team create VMs in one shared subnet only.

## Steps

1. **Get the right role.** You need **Shared VPC Admin** (`roles/compute.xpnAdmin`) on the organization or folder.

2. **Create two projects** under the same organization, for example `net-host-XXXX` and `app-svc-XXXX`, both linked to billing, with the Compute Engine API enabled.

3. **Create the network in the host project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks create shared-vpc --subnet-mode=custom --project=HOST_PROJECT
gcloud compute networks subnets create app-subnet \
  --network=shared-vpc --region=us-central1 --range=10.20.0.0/24 --project=HOST_PROJECT
gcloud compute networks subnets create db-subnet \
  --network=shared-vpc --region=us-central1 --range=10.20.1.0/24 --project=HOST_PROJECT</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Enable Shared VPC and attach the service project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute shared-vpc enable HOST_PROJECT
gcloud compute shared-vpc associated-projects add SERVICE_PROJECT --host-project=HOST_PROJECT</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Share one subnet only.** Grant **Compute Network User** on `app-subnet`, not on the whole host project.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks subnets add-iam-policy-binding app-subnet \
  --region=us-central1 --project=HOST_PROJECT \
  --member=group:gcp-developers@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/compute.networkUser</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Create a VM in the service project on the shared subnet.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create svc-vm --project=SERVICE_PROJECT \
  --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro --no-address \
  --subnet=projects/HOST_PROJECT/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/app-subnet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Using `db-subnet` fails for the developers group.

7. **Clean up.** Delete the VM, detach the project, disable Shared VPC and delete the network.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete svc-vm --project=SERVICE_PROJECT --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute shared-vpc associated-projects remove SERVICE_PROJECT --host-project=HOST_PROJECT
gcloud compute shared-vpc disable HOST_PROJECT</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Network control | Central team in the host project |
| App teams | Create VMs in service projects |
| Subnet-level access | Teams use only the subnets you share |
| Firewall rules | Managed in the host project |
